consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
restraint and placarding of transported loads

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at LA-7202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on LA-7202 and ZV-7211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically selecting, fit-testing and maintaining respirators. LA-7202 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 20 November 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on LA-7202 and ZV-7211 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
